description: Trend + level + signal confluence on gold H1, stop 1.5x the strategy's own, fixed 4R target. strategy_lab 2026-09-19: tuned on the first 60% of 3 years of H1, then +$4,098 on the unseen last 40% (77 trades, 31% win rate, +$2,904 without its 3 best trades) at $100 risk. Starts at half the lab's 0.95% size, and opts out of the gates its backtest never saw.
